fusions.name: Culling Hatchet
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet at a straggler up to 7 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Heel Chop
fusions.desc: A low chop that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Notched Deadfall
fusions.desc: Sets a deadfall of cut timber at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles brings it down, dealing 24 damage to everything within 2 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Running Swing
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover raises your critical hit chance by 30% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
